title: Parkour Runner with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a Three.js parkour runner game featuring undo/redo mechanics. Load the 'ABeautifulGame.glb' model using GLTFLoader from a CDN (use unpkg or jsdelivr for Three.js r152+ and its addons).

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a 3D scene with a perspective camera at position (0, 8, 15) looking at the origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- The ground is a large flat plane (100x100) colored #3a7d44 (green grass) with receiveShadow.
- Generate a series of 8 floating platforms arranged in a parkour course. Each platform is a BoxGeometry(2, 0.4, 2) with color #8B4513. Platforms are positioned at increasing X values (spaced 3-4 units apart) with varying Y heights (between 1 and 6) and slight Z offsets. Store platform positions in an array.
- Load 'ABeautifulGame.glb' and scale it to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5). Place it as a decorative trophy on the final (8th) platform. This is the goal object.

PLAYER:
- The player is a capsule-like shape: a CylinderGeometry(0.3, 0.3, 1, 8) with a SphereGeometry(0.3) on top, merged or grouped. Color: #FF4444. Start position: on top of platform 0 (the first platform).
- The player has a velocity vector and is affected by gravity (acceleration = -15 units/s²).
- The player can stand on platforms (collision detection: check if player bottom is near platform top and within XZ bounds of platform ± 1.0 unit).

MOVEMENT & PHYSICS:
- Arrow Left/Right or A/D: move player left/right (X axis) at speed 5 units/s.
- Arrow Up or W: move player forward (negative Z) at speed 5 units/s.
- Arrow Down or S: move player backward (positive Z) at speed 5 units/s.
- Spacebar: jump. Apply upward velocity of 8 units/s. Only allow jumping when grounded.
- Apply gravity each frame. If player falls below Y=-5, reset to start platform (this counts as a fall).

UNDO/REDO SYSTEM:
- Every 0.5 seconds while the game is active, save a snapshot of the player state: {position: {x,y,z}, velocity: {x,y,z}, currentPlatform: index, isGrounded: bool}.
- Press 'Z' key to UNDO: restore the previous snapshot. Maintain a history stack (max 50 entries) and a redo stack.
- Press 'Y' key to REDO: restore the next snapshot from the redo stack.
- When the player performs a new action after an undo, clear the redo stack.
- Display undo/redo stack sizes in the HUD.

HUD / UI:
- Top-left: display 'Platform: X/8' showing which platform the player is currently on or nearest to.
- Top-center: display 'Time: XX.Xs' as elapsed game time.
- Top-right: display 'Falls: N' counting how many times the player fell.
- Bottom-left: display 'Undo: N | Redo: N' showing stack sizes.
- Bottom-center: display 'GOAL REACHED!' in gold text when the player reaches the final platform.
- Add a DOM button with id='resetBtn' labeled 'Reset Game' that resets everything to initial state.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- playerPosition: {x, y, z} (current player position)
- playerVelocity: {x, y, z}
- currentPlatform: number (0-7, -1 if airborne/fallen)
- isGrounded: boolean
- fallCount: number
- elapsedTime: number (seconds)
- undoStackSize: number
- redoStackSize: number
- goalReached: boolean
- platformCount: 8 (constant)
- totalPlatforms: array of {x, y, z} positions
- gameActive: boolean
- historyRecordCount: number (total snapshots ever taken)

Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Gravity = -15 units/s². Jump velocity = 8 units/s upward. Horizontal speed = 5 units/s. Player resets if Y < -5. Platform collision: player bottom within platform top ± 0.3 units vertically and within platform XZ bounds ± 1.0 unit. Undo snapshots taken every 0.5 seconds.
